description: Set the status of one of this shop's listings: active (on sale), sold, or hidden from the site without deleting it. Setting active again undoes sold or hidden, unless it is refused (a held account, a pending licence check) with a reason code. Returns the listing's `id` and the `status` it now has.

id.description: The listing to change: its id (such as `cmh0q2x8f0001...`), from list_listings, get_listing or create_listing

status.description: sold once the item has gone to a buyer, hidden to take it off the site for now (e.g. out of stock), or active to put it back on sale

name: set_listing_status

id.description: The id of the listing whose status was set, as you passed it; get_listing reads the listing as it now stands

status.description: The status the listing has now. active: on sale (public once verified). sold: kept on the site, marked sold. hidden: off the site but not deleted

title: Set listing status
